notes.pt:
- No arquivo de origem o LoRA estava em bypass (rodava como Qwen puro com 25 steps); aqui foi reativado com 4 steps, a receita do LoRA.
- Créditos: layout e testes do workflow por Tensor Alchemist; LoRA da Viggle (licença de pesquisa da Qwen).
notes.en:
- In the source file the LoRA was bypassed (it ran as plain Qwen at 25 steps); here it was re-enabled with 4 steps, the LoRA's recipe.
- Credits: workflow layout and tests by Tensor Alchemist; LoRA by Viggle (Qwen research license).
